nobody-covers-here.name: No local news
nobody-covers-here.line: Nobody reports on my town any more, so I don't know what's going on here.
nobody-covers-here.why: Brings back what the ID names (no one covering here) and says why the person doesn't know, while the problem-style name matches Misinformation if the founder wants one style for the heading.

nobody-covers-here.name: Local news
nobody-covers-here.line: Nobody reports on what's happening in my town any more.
nobody-covers-here.why: Keeps the current name and the plain everyday sentence, but points at the missing coverage rather than the person's own not knowing.

watched-by-companies.name: Being tracked
watched-by-companies.line: I feel watched by companies that know everything about me.
watched-by-companies.why: Same line; the problem-style name says what is wrong, so the heading no longer mixes Misinformation (a problem) with Privacy (an area).

dont-know-whats-true.name: Knowing what's true
dont-know-whats-true.line: I don't know what's true any more.
dont-know-whats-true.why: Same line; an area-style name matching Local news and Privacy, the other way to give the heading one style.
